slide1.title: Learn to build software with AI, by practicing for real
slide1.description: Interactive Vibe Coding practices with feedback from an AI tutor and evaluation based on explicit criteria.

slide2.title: An AI tutor with controlled tools and full traceability
slide2.description: Hints and feedback from an agent with clear iteration and token limits — every decision is logged.

slide3.title: Build object-counting prototypes with an explicit rule
slide3.description: Compare your results against a human reference and understand the limits of what a model can infer from an image.

step1.description: Filter the catalog by type, level or technology and read its objectives.

step2.title: Practice with AI
step2.description: Build or debug your solution with on-demand assistance from an AI tutor.

step3.title: Submit and evaluate
step3.description: Your result is evaluated against explicit criteria: numeric, count-based or manual.

step4.title: Get feedback
step4.description: Compare your prediction, get feedback and try again as many times as you like.

testimonials.title: What the people who use it say

voice1.quote: Having to predict the result before running it forced me to understand the model, not just copy AI-generated code.

voice2.quote: Comparing my count against the human reference showed me exactly where my rule failed and how to fix it.

voice3.quote: The AI tutor's traceability — which tool it used and why — lets me trust what the agent reports.
